CustomField.description: Used to display the address in the compact layout
CustomField.formula: Address__Street__s & IF(OR(ISBLANK(Address__Street__s), ISBLANK(Address__City__s & TEXT(Address__StateCode__s) & Address__PostalCode__s)), "", BR()) & Address__City__s & IF(OR(ISBLANK(Address__City__s), ISBLANK(TEXT(Address__StateCode__s) & Address__PostalCode__s)), "", ", ") & TEXT(Address__StateCode__s) & IF(OR(ISBLANK(TEXT(Address__StateCode__s)), ISBLANK(Address__PostalCode__s)), "", " ") & Address__PostalCode__s
CustomField.label: Address
